analysis_kind: exploratory, conditional on inclusion in the scored archive

settings.multiplicity: Holm correction within all 15 model pairs separately for each difficulty; no correction across difficulties

uncertainty_units.success_intervals: Wilson 95% score intervals over ten task seeds per model/difficulty, conditional on scored archive inclusion; illustrative task-sampling uncertainty under a binomial sampling model
uncertainty_units.paired_comparisons: Task seed within one difficulty. A draw retains the two models' outcomes on the same task; models are never treated as independent samples on that task.
uncertainty_units.confidence: One run on one task. First average all causally paired a/b/c observations within the run; then weight supported runs equally. Resample whole supported runs with their reports and coefficient blocks intact, conditional on having a paired report.
uncertainty_units.calibration_gap: Signed calibration-in-the-large gap: mean within-run confidence minus mean within-run correctness, then averaged equally across runs. Positive means overconfidence; zero alone does not imply calibration, and this is not ECE.
uncertainty_units.confidence_event: The preceding solve has block maximum absolute coefficient error E_q < 0.1; reports pair only to strictly earlier transcript turns; source f is excluded.
uncertainty_units.scope: Six model policies evaluated on 30 seed/difficulty tasks (ten per difficulty), with one retained scored record per model/task. No repeated model-sampling runs or complete attempt history are available.
limitations: Intervals do not account for missing attempts, retries, archive selection, implementation drift, or model-sampling variability.
Ten tasks per difficulty give coarse tests and potentially degenerate empirical bootstrap intervals; these intervals do not establish universal rates or model rankings.
Seed labels are reused across difficulties. Analyses and resampling remain within difficulty and do not assume independence across difficulties.
Paired percentile intervals are unadjusted exploratory intervals; only exact paired test p-values receive the stated Holm correction.
These resampling distributions describe sensitivity to the ten observed tasks under exchangeable task-sampling assumptions; they do not prove the archive is representative of a target population.
Report count is not an independent sample size. Runs without causally paired confidence reports are excluded from confidence estimands and their seeds are listed.
